name: genfstab
description: Generate fstab entries for a root

options.name: -f
options.description: Restrict output to mountpoints matching the prefix FILTER

options.name: -L
options.description: Use labels for source identifiers (shortcut for -t LABEL)

options.name: -t
options.description: Use TAG for source identifiers (TAG should be one of: LABEL, UUID, PARTLABEL, PARTUUID)

options.name: -U
options.description: Use UUIDs for source identifiers (shortcut for -t UUID)
